name: Mira Thorne
text: A wiry, sharp-eyed scout who trusts no one further than she can throw a knife.

name: Cassian Veyra
text:
Cassian is tall and lean, with close-cropped grey hair and a soldier's stiff posture, even at rest. He dresses plainly, favoring a dark travelling cloak over anything that marks him as a man of rank.

He speaks rarely and never raises his voice, preferring silence to argument. Those who serve under him say his calm is more unsettling than any shout would be, and that he weighs every word before he spends it.

He commanded a border garrison for eleven years before it fell to a siege he still blames himself for. He has not returned to soldiering since, and flinches, almost imperceptibly, at the sound of a watchman's bell.

name: Dorran Kessick
text:
Appearance: Broad-shouldered and shaved bald, with a faded raven tattoo curling across the left side of his neck and down past his collar.

Personality: Blunt almost to a fault, loyal once he's given his word, and quick to laugh loudly at his own jokes even when no one else does.

name: Lyse Ardent
text: Lyse keeps her hair pinned back on the left side to hide a puckered scar along her cheekbone, left by a kiln accident when she was twelve. She still works the forge most mornings, scar and all, and bristles if anyone offers to spare her the hot work because of it.
